scope: Scarlet Crystal guest top-screen overlap, touch access, rotation, remote guest render and related resident regressions
current_baseline: P35 signed iPhone SourceCommit75455528540a84640656ece681de3053ceea4c74 session3d8246a5 iOS27.2: 234 events (seq1..234), host 440x956 safeTop62. PID3244 normal guest emitted 650/2600ms content geometry, visible unsafe controls0 and images 0->1 outside scroll, no severe y<42 controls so P35 ancestor probe correctly had no nodes. PID3252 second guest (two switcher entries) launched and root safeTop62 with P28 manual/P33 ALWAYS quarantines, audio resume ACK, but it never emitted guest_content_geometry_probe nor guest_ancestor_layout_probe at either 650ms or2600ms despite >30s session. P35's weak UIWindow/root scheduled callbacks can exit silently; no definitive reason or top content geometry was recorded. Auth host_session_unavailable after earlier restored caused manual_blocked reason auth_unavailable; subsequent user-initiated 2FA verified and host_session_restored, SideStore cert provider reused same cert and readback ready, no native refresh attempted. P36 instruments exact snapshot scheduling/skips and optional single attached replacement-root read at existing 2600ms; no visual fix claims.
current_issue_status: UNRESOLVED: root-level safeTop62 does not prove guest header controls inside safe area. P35 severe-layout ancestor proof never emitted for PID3252 because no guest geometry snapshots; only normal PID3244 sampled. P36 distinguishes window released, root replaced/stale, hidden, scene orientation, root detached, missing safe area and invalid frame via anonymous host JSONL. At already scheduled 2600ms only, a replaced root may be read without modifying UI; P35 ancestry probe remains and will run only if severely unsafe controls exist. Authentication unavailable before 2FA blocks manual native refresh despite present LC cert; after verified login session restored but no manual operation/error made, so SideStore native-error forwarding L078 still untested. Keyboard resign ACK and audio focus Darwin ACK not physical verification; installed automatic refresh false with retry deferred.
confidence_note: Past-chat-only historical versions were reported in earlier conversations; not all have a GitHub revision or device verification. An implementation, a CI success, a telemetry event, and a real device visual fix are distinct.
privacy: No credentials, Apple ID, OTP, UDID, guest names or device identifiers are stored.

New machine-readable checks and a front-of-report decision index independently address enforcement and observability, without touching guest screen geometry or repeating any failed Dynamic Island fix.
entries.action: Create rebuild/diagnostics/scarlet_no_repeat_gate.py with pre-edit proposal mode and CI-test validation: compare problem and normalized mechanism aliases against unresolved prior attempts; reject exact repeated normalized source before/after even under a renamed mechanism; require novelty causal difference, falsifiable prediction, prior attempt IDs and if repeating a failed mechanism new device commit/event/observed value. Add dedicated tests with deliberate failed Safe Area and renamed-code examples. Add remediationDecisionIndex() to HostApp DiagnosticRecorder and render a compact recent 18-entry decision ledger before JSONL; retain full immutable historical JSON and handoff prompt after JSONL. Update bundled AI handoff instructions with mandatory pre-edit CLI usage and latest SDK override evidence. Add explicit no-repeat CI command before native integration, correct regex literal escaping, allow anonymous elapsed_ms through recorder, guard elapsed_ms via static test, normalize related guest_boot/guest_top/rotation_top problems and reject no-diff proposals.

before: # Scarlet Crystal — 로그 한 개로 이어서 수정하는 AI 전용 지침 (R6P10)
after: # Scarlet Crystal — 로그 한 개로 이어서 수정하는 AI 전용 지침 (R6P13)
이 보고서는 단순 런타임 로그가 아니라 다음 코드 변경을 결정하는 **보존된 실패 실험 기록**이다.
- 보고서 앞부분 \`NO-REPEAT DECISION INDEX\`는 최근 수정 ID/버전/원인 메커니즘/상태/코드 파일을 먼저 보여준다. 전체 변경 전후 원본 코드와 커밋은 뒤의 \`REMEDIATION HISTORY\`에 보존된다. 앞부분만 보고 이전 이력이 없다고 판단하지 않는다.
- 수정 **전에** 후보 작업을 JSON으로 작성해 \`python3 rebuild/diagnostics/scarlet_no_repeat_gate.py --proposal proposal.json\`을 실행한다. 실패하면 코드 수정을 시작하지 않는다.

- \`novelty.prior_excluded_ids\`, \`novelty.causal_difference\`, \`novelty.falsifiable_prediction\`은 필수다. 동일 실패 원인을 다시 사용할 경우 실제 기기에서 얻은 \`source_commit/event/observed_value\`와 이전 방식이 실패한 구체적 이유까지 제출해야 한다.
- 소스의 변경 전후가 기존 이력과 실질적으로 같은 경우, 메커니즘 이름이나 버전만 바꿔도 \`NO-REPEAT-BLOCK\`으로 거부한다. 빈 전후 코드·diff hunk가 없는 새 조치도 거부한다.
- CI 테스트가 같은 검증 함수를 호출하여 **빌드 시작 전** 이력을 검사한다. 프로그램이 인과관계의 모든 동의어를 자동 이해한다고 가정하지 않는다. 의미적으로 유사한 조치는 앞의 \`재시도 판별 키\`에 따라 추가로 수동/AI 검토해야 한다.
- 새 작업이 성공하지 못한 경우에도 실패 사실과 수정 코드 범위를 \`Lxxx\`에 남긴다. 새 로그를 받으면 이전 실패 메커니즘은 자동 제외 후보이며, 성공으로 바꾸려면 별도 실기기 시각·터치 증거가 필요하다.

source_revisions.title: fix(r6p14): collapse switcher before guest selection and home exit
fix(r6p14): reset retained panel lifecycle on home, activate and enqueue
test(r6p14): prevent expanded panel carryover on guest navigation
fix(r6p14): immediate navigation close without morph
fix(r6p14): request immediate close during resident scene navigation
test(r6p14): immediate close and V25 compatibility
ci(r6p14): unique unsigned release and build branch

novelty.causal_difference: L047 targeted delayed mount/opacity of recent rows; R6P14 targets the independent navigation state machine where the host hides a retained UIWindow while @State isOpen remains expanded or close happens after onSwitch. It closes before navigation, not by waiting for a render/mount tick.
novelty.falsifiable_prediction: In an installed R6P14 iPhone report, tapping B or leaving A for Home emits switch_panel_dismissed or switch_panel_navigation_reset before the next guest activation / fullscreen_scene_home; reopening B shows the collapsed round button first, then current A/B rows on tap.

new_device_evidence.observed_value: count 2 at 02:50:27.044 vs first later explicit dismiss at 02:50:34.391 UTC

novelty.why_prior_fix_failed: L047 eagerly mounted recent app rows but did not modify the switchTo/onExit ordering or retained SceneStack UIWindow visibility transitions.

entries.repeat_policy: If R6P14 still expands after navigation, inspect ordering of switch_panel_navigation_reset, switch_panel_dismissed and resulting rendered state; do not reapply the same lifecycle calls or repeat L047 row-mount edits.
entries.success_gate: Source gate and all 491 static tests pass, Xcode 27.2 build yields unique unsigned R6P14 IPA and nonoverwritten prior releases; on iPhone A expanded -> B selected and A expanded -> Home -> B launched both immediately restore collapsed button; new panel opens with A/B rows first frame and no fullscreen size/orientation regression. Inspect switch_panel_navigation_close_applied receipt on device, not only switch_panel_navigation_reset request.
entries.privacy: Anonymous transition reasons and counts only; no guest names or identifiers exported.

entries.hypothesis: R6P13 iPhone report showed 62pt normal host window and remote hosting-owner top yet visual island collision continued. Host FBScene metrics do not establish the UIKit safe-area inset consumed by the guest app own root VC, launched inside LiveProcess after host UI initialization. Test the root only after a real guest UIWindow becomes visible or key; never hook all UIKit methods.
entries.action: Preserve R6P14 switcher/navigation behavior and display scale. Publish anonymous normal UIWindow portrait safe-top in LC App Group only when 20..130pt; inject separate opt-in LiveProcess tweak with UIKit UIWindow lifecycle notification observers (not global swizzling). Compare the guest root UIView.safeAreaInsets.top to max of guest statusBarFrame and verified host top; set only the missing delta via UIViewController.additionalSafeAreaInsets after the guest root has a window. Skip landscape, wrong/not-attached windows, already safe roots, bad/missing target and non-resident processes. Publish PID-scoped anonymous root before/after receipts back to host logs. Add five source/generator tests and independent R6P15 unsigned IPA branch. Pre-build safety hardening: wait for two bounded UIKit layout samples before first correction; associate one owned extra-top delta per guest root to prohibit double padding on UIWindow visible+key notifications. If system safe top resolves later, trim only our additional excess, without altering any app-added original insets.
entries.observation: Only prior iPhone SourceCommit e6afe296a535 is observed: normal UIWindow safeTop=62, temporary host viewport top 0, remote owner readback=62, yet guest top bars were reported obscured. New guest-root before/after values have not yet been measured on a real iPhone. 496 local Python regression tests, generator test, YAML parser and git diff --check passed. Native Xcode integration, iPhone optical and touch proof pending. Follow-up guest root race hardening and extended 496/496 source suite pass; these are source verifications, not iPhone visual success. Xcode 27.2 LiveContainer native-engine build succeeded in workflow run 43150404935. iPhone visual correction is still unverified.
evidence: 2026-11-12 iPhone report session 7b3e207c: safearea 62->0->62 and owner -1->62 for two guest launches.
User reports Instagram and potentially other guest apps with island-obscured top controls despite previous 62pt host readbacks.
Original Apple UIKit additionalSafeAreaInsets public root container contract; window-root attachment is required before reading safeAreaInsets.
All exact source hunks captured under code_locations; opt-in bit precedes LiveProcess bootstrap.

before: // R6P11: anonymous guest Mach-O SDK contract, no identifier/path.
after: // R6P11: anonymous guest Mach-O SDK contract, no identifier/path.
// Guest-owned UIKit readback only; no names, screenshots or bundle IDs.

before: // Keep prior scene visible until this exact remote process reports
// readiness; never flash an uninitialized black child scene.
after: // Keep prior scene visible until this exact remote process reports
// readiness; never flash an uninitialized black child scene.
// R6P15: guest-only safe-area correction evidence. The guest writes an
// anonymous bounded readback into the existing LC App Group and posts a
// PID-scoped Darwin notification. A host hosting-owner 62pt readback alone
// is not proof that the guest UIKit root received a safe content region.
readBack() // Reconcile a receipt sent before the listener attached.
guard let token = row["receipt"] as? String,
let result = row["result"] as? String else { continue }
// R6P15: the host alone knows the normal-window island inset before
// remote LiveProcess UIKit starts. Share only this anonymous geometry
// as a fallback for the guest's OWN root-controller safe-area check.
// Never publish the transient viewport zero or an overlay window.
# R6P15: only at the guest's own UIKit root, not host FBScene geometry.
// R6P15: reconcile the real guest UIWindow root safe area after attachment.
// No global UIKit hook, UIApplication.sharedApplication, scene/frame transform,
// bundle rewrite, display-scale adjustment, or per-app exceptions.
// Host safe-top fallback is anonymous normal UIWindow geometry; the
// correction itself is applied inside the real guest UI root.
// Only the missing amount is added; UIKit updates its layout guide,
// never the view's pixel frame or the guest app's drawing scale.
CGFloat deficit = MIN(130, MAX(0, target - before));
// The resident opt-in bit is supplied before LC guest bootstrap; all
// classic LC, embedded SideStore, and unrelated extensions remain inert.
"""R6P15: guest-owned top safe area and bounded saved-pairing reconnect."""
self.assertIn("CGFloat deficit = MIN(130, MAX(0, target - before));", GUEST)

entries.hypothesis: R6P16 iPhone log has 2 guest LiveProcess launches and SDK decision traces, yet zero guest_root_safearea_receipt. In original pinned LiveProcess/main.m the resident bit is set in NSUserDefaults.standardUserDefaults before LiveContainerMain; NUDGuestHooksInit in pinned Tweaks/NSUserDefaults.m replaces this default object with per-guest defaults before the Island guard initializer. R6P15 incorrectly checked the replaced object, so guard can silently skip all UIWindow observer installation despite host 62pt safe area.
entries.action: Use the original LC NSUserDefaults.lcUserDefaults retained by LiveContainerMain to read Scarlet.ResidentSDKContract.V1 inside R6P15 existing guard; do not change the root additionalSafeAreaInsets, screen geometry, per-app policies, XPC order or animation. Emit guest_root_guard_armed through existing app-group PID-scoped guest receipt channel before registering original window observers, to distinguish successful initialization from actual root correction. Add 5 activation/storage-domain tests and preserve the complete per-commit/line history in L053. Add a unique R6P17 paired native build/release branch.

Pinned upstream source confirms NSUserDefaults object reassignment. 508 local Python source regressions PASS including 5 new R6P17 cases. Actual R6P17 native CI and iPhone guest_root_guard_armed, guest_root_corrected, visual/touch still pending.

Pinned LiveContainer 9108ae624ea001f7d7696d48407f890b48fa2653 LiveProcess/main.m and LC bootstrap write resident optin to original standard defaults, then NUDGuestHooksInit replaces standard defaults with guest app domain before island initializer.

Existing R6P15 source checks NSUserDefaults.standardUserDefaults for the opt-in, so wrong defaults domain can result in early return; hypothesis grounded in source ordering, not solely from missing log.

## 8. R6P17: P15 보정기 비활성화의 독립 원인 — 원본 LC UserDefaults와 게스트 전용 UserDefaults
52건 L001~L052의 전체 내역, 게스트 2개 실행과 패널 즉시 접기를 확인하지만,
`guest_root_safearea_receipt`를 **한 번도** 포함하지 않는다. 따라서 Safe Area가
62pt라는 호스트 기록을 R6P15의 실제 게스트 루트 보정 성공으로 해석할 수 없다.
원본 LC가 기록한 플래그를 찾지 못하면 조용히 종료할 수 있다. 이 메커니즘은 이전
Safe Area/FBScene/호스트 프레임 수정과 무관한 **시작 조건·저장소 동일성** 결함이다.
**읽는 객체만** 교체한다. 나머지 화면 배율, 상단 여백 공식, root.additionalSafeAreaInsets,
다이나믹 아일랜드 회피값, 버튼, 멀티탭, 페어링, 인증서는 변경하지 않는다.
게스트 프로세스 PID별로 우선 기록되어야 한다. 이후 `guest_root_already_safe`,
시작 이벤트만으로 화면 겹침이 해결됐다고 판정할 수는 없다.
- 새 로그에서 `guest_root_guard_armed` 없이 SDK 선택 로그만 반복된다면
P17도 실패 상태로 보고 주입·빌드 연계 또는 알림 수신 경로를 별개로 조사한다.
`guard_armed`가 발생하지만 상단이 여전히 가려지면 Safe Area 값을 더 더하는
대신 실제 화면 콘텐츠와 Safe Area 무시 여부를 검증한다. 다른 앱도 동일 기준으로 검사한다.
갱신의 `installation_verified=false`는 이번 상단 문제와 독립된 미해결 결함이다.
R6P17 수정에 설치 성공/페어링 성공을 귀속시키지 않는다.

entries.repeat_policy: Do not add another Safe Area correction, root offset multiplier, scene frame transform, delayed layout, or per-app exception. First verify guest_root_guard_armed in R6P17 device export. If absent investigate build/link/injection and notification path, not reapply this defaults substitution. If present with overlapping controls investigate actual guest content geometry independently.

entries.success_gate: R6P17 paired iOS native source compiled, unique unsigned IPA release; iPhone log shows guard armed plus at least one root readback and actual app controls/touch unobscured in portrait; verify multiple guests and landscape do not regress. CI/test alone cannot prove visual success.
entries.privacy: No Apple account, app name, guest ID, pairing file or OTP disclosed.

entries.hypothesis: R6P17 on-device with source 9ea728f and both LiveProcess PIDs 4585,4593 proves their guest UIView root Safe Area is 62pt: guest_root_guard_armed x2, guest_root_already_safe x7, guest_root_corrected x0. Previous host, UIWindow and root Safe Area or SDK rework therefore cannot be blindly repeated. Upper interactive content may use its own coordinates or ignore root safe layout. Measure actual descendant UIKit controls and scroll views in window coordinates, without touching guest geometry.
entries.action: Add read-only bounded guest process probe to existing activated IslandContentGuard only after its existing already-safe root observation; sample same resident UIWindow root once at 650ms and again 2600ms, cap 640 descendants, depth 9, classify visible controls/UIAccessibilityTraitButton and scroll views, count candidate controls crossing independently observed safe-top, and report anonymous numeric metrics through existing PID-scoped App Group notifier. Add host relay and diagnostic field whitelist so metrics cannot be silently dropped. No UI frames, safe area deltas, display scale, app-specific exceptions, or privacy-sensitive view identities changed. Add 6 source regressions and unique R6P18 paired build/unsigned release workflow.

Guest launch history A/B count=2 and panel navigation reset observed; IPA source download separately fails NSURLErrorDomain -1005, manual refresh installation_verified=false. 514 local Python unit/source tests PASS. Previously inspected pinned LiveContainer 9108ae624ea0 has no proof that every descendant uses UIView safeAreaLayoutGuide; Apple public docs distinguish a root layout guide from actual descendant layout.

novelty.causal_difference: Unlike L039 guest-wide UIKit/window measurements, L050 own-root Safe Area correction or L053 optin activation, R6P18 measures visible *descendant* interactive view rectangles and scroll top in guest UIWindow coordinates. It does not change safe inset, root view, window geometry or SDK, and only emits anonymous bounded metrics.
novelty.falsifiable_prediction: R6P18 real iPhone log will include per-process guest_content_geometry_probe for attached resident roots, with candidate controls count, unsafe controls count, root guide/frame and scan truncation flag. unsafe_controls>0 is a candidate content placement violation, not a visual proof; 0 with scan_capped or virtual SwiftUI elements is inconclusive. Fixes require matching guest-visible controls and touch evidence after a separate causal intervention.

R6P17 수정에 설치 성공/페어링 성공을 귀속시키지 않는다.
## 9. R6P17 실기기 반증과 R6P18 하위 콘텐츠 좌표 진단
`guest_root_corrected`는 0회. 이 결과는 R6P17 원본 LC Defaults 플래그
수정으로 보정기가 활성화됐다는 것을 증명하지만 상단 버튼 시각·터치
해결을 증명하지 않는다. 기존 `additionalSafeAreaInsets`를 다시 더하거나
FBScene/윈도 프레임을 조정하는 반복 수정은 금지한다.
- 첫 게스트 뒤 두 번째 실행 `recent_session_registered(count=2)`와
이 오류는 P16의 `-999`(취소)와 다르며, 자동갱신도 여전히
- 새 인과 가설: **루트 Safe Area의 62pt는 실제 하위 컨트롤이 62pt
아래에 배치됐다는 증거가 아니다.** 원본 UIKit에서도 각 UIView의
제약 조건과 개별 Safe Area 반영 여부는 다르다. 따라서 R6P18은
게스트 프로세스 내부의 현재 UIKit UIWindow에서 실제 하위 UIView 중
버튼/조작 요소 후보와 UIScrollView의 윈도 좌표를 **읽기 전용**으로
측정한다. 첫 안정 레이아웃 후 650ms/2600ms 두 번, 최대 640뷰·깊이 9로
제한. 어떤 화면 크기, 인셋, UI 프레임도 변경하지 않는다.
수집은 금지한다. `unsafe_controls>0`이면 안전 영역을 실제 침범한
컨트롤 후보의 경로를 추가 검증한다. **0이어도** SwiftUI 가상 요소나
탐색 한계로 빠졌을 수 있으므로 시각 해결로 판정할 수 없다.
- R6P18은 화면 수정본이 아니라 **새 위치 계층의 원인 검증 빌드**다.

novelty.causal_difference: R6P18 iPhone current launch and multiple earlier archived sessions show source-only HTTPS download failed after about 2 seconds with NSURLErrorDomain -1005, not unrelated source cancellation -999, guest render, or Apple's signing entitlement. Existing source UI's URLSession.download(from:) was strictly one-shot with no resume bytes handling or network-loss recovery. entries.repeat_policy: If pinned SideStore still fails, review exact Xcode errors; do not make the original private session public or bypass 2FA, portal team authorization or file-keychain checks.

entries.privacy: Only in-memory previously verified session reference reused; no credentials, tokens or OTP are logged or added to App Groups or user defaults.

entries.hypothesis: The R6P20 on-device guest content probe executed in two normal running guests but returned scan_capped=true at only 46 and 15 UIKit views despite 640 node allowance; this is necessarily the earlier depth>9 traversal limit. entries.action: Keep existing 650/2600 ms main-thread, one-root bounded read-only probe, increase node cap to 1200, depth to 24, separate depthCapped and countCapped, record maximum depth and window-space frames of visible UILabel/UITextView/UITextField/UIImageView top nodes and scroll regions (counts and first Y only). Preserve all existing no-UI-write, root 62 pt correction, foreground/range, SDK and host geometry behavior. Python 531 tests pass, native build pending.
evidence: Current R6P20 PID5497: first sample seq96 and last seq117, guide y62 root y0, visited46, candidate_controls7, unsafe_controls0, scan_capped=true.
PID5506: seq156 and 179, guide y62 root y0, visited15, candidate_controls0, scroll_top_without_inset3, scan_capped=true.
Pinned R6P18 scanner source returns scan capped for depth>9 or visited>=640, so these two scans failed at depth, not number of nodes.

novelty.causal_difference: R6P20 real iPhone shows both live guest roots correctly safe at 62pt, and R6P18 probe actually ran, yet returns scan_capped=true for only visited=46 and visited=15 while root views contain nested UIKit/SwiftUI subtrees. Existing limit depth>9 marks scan capped before reaching interactive text/buttons, making unsafe_controls=0 non-evidence. R6P21 increases only bounded read-only depth and records separate depth-versus-count truncation and anonymous text/image element frames. No UI safe-area, frame, SDK, overlay, guest-specific exceptions, or scale writes; this is independent instrumentation for a proven sampling blind spot, not rerunning any old Safe Area change.
novelty.falsifiable_prediction: New R6P21 device guest geometry receipts include max_depth_seen, depth_capped, count_capped and top/unsafe text and image counts. In previously capped 15/46-view roots, depth>9 is scanned to maximum 24 or until 1200 visible descendants; a zero unsafe count with depth_capped=true remains inconclusive and requires a different accessibility/compositing path. A positive y<62 shows actual visual candidates for a targeted follow-up fix, not automatic screen correction.

new_device_evidence.observed_value: 2026-11-12T06:50:21Z PID5497 samples 650/2600: root guide 62, visited 46, candidate controls7, unsafe0, scan_capped true; PID5506 samples 650/2600: root guide62, visited15, controls0, scroll_top_without_inset3, scan_capped true. entries.hypothesis: App opacity and guest AVAudioSession deactivation are not UIKit input focus transfer. The old LiveProcess may remain first responder, leaving a system keyboard visible over the next remote guest.
entries.action: Provide a resident-only guest UIKit hook registered in the original TweakLoader bootstrap. Host sends PID-scoped keyboard dismissal BEFORE hiding the outgoing guest and when going Home. Only that guest normal UIWindow receives endEditing:YES; log bounded request, first-responder release and keyboardDidHide acknowledgments. Preserve guest text and all audio and scene state.
entries.observation: The user reported old guest keyboard appearing over newly switched guest. R6P23 log shows PID6807 resident on Home, PID6821 launched; code lacked guest-side focus release. Audio pause/resume device acknowledgments returned OK for the two PIDs, but no acoustic mixing proof. R6P24 source/tests passed; keyboard visual dismissal and audio listening not yet device verified.
evidence: R6P23 08:19:38.822Z guest PID6821 started with PID6807 retained; previous overlay transition only changed opacity and enabled state.
R6P23 audio guest_audio_device_receipt pause for PID6807 and resume for PID6821 both OK; this confirms setActive return not measured audio silence.
R6P24 source regression tests require outgoing PID keyboard release before opacity change, home release, guest-only hook, genuine keyboardDidHide receipt, no change to audio and display scale.
entries.repeat_policy: On iPhone require outgoing guest_keyboard_dismiss_requested and guest_keyboard_device_receipt, and if keyboard actually appeared require keyboard_hidden acknowledgment before claiming user-visible fix. Distinguish a lost old PID command from no_owned_window and from a keyboard that remains despite endEditing; do not clear input content or restart LiveProcess.
entries.privacy: No keyboard text, view names, app identity, password, OTP, screenshot or app-signing data in telemetry.

novelty.causal_difference: Earlier audio focus isolation pauses a LiveProcess AVAudioSession and scene opacity, but neither causes UIKit to resign the outgoing guest first responder; the keyboard survives across the remote scene handoff.
novelty.falsifiable_prediction: On switching from A with its keyboard shown to B, outgoing guest PID will receive guest_keyboard_dismiss_requested and a matching first responder receipt; UIKit keyboardDidHide will also be logged if the guest observes a real hide event.

new_device_evidence.observed_value: Outgoing PID6807 retained and new PID6821 started while root remained full screen; source has no outgoing endEditing and new refresh stage names are missing from host allowlist.

novelty.why_prior_fix_failed: Previous L065 placed stage-specific errors at native origin but host executor still blocks new values; audio pause in L037 only deactivates AVAudioSession and does not release UIKit keyboard focus.

source_revisions.title: R6P24 outgoing guest keyboard focus handoff and native refresh stage relay

This changes the terminal JSONL allowlist and asserts the complete guest→relay→recorder contract, not guest geometry, app/scene, XPC, or Safe Area.

novelty.why_prior_fix_failed: L068 changed only guest clipping measurements and host relay. The final `ScarletDiagnosticRecorder.allowedFields.contains(key)` filter was unchanged and explicitly rejects unknown fields at export, so all R6P25 numbers were discarded.

entries.action: Add the exact four missing numeric-only fields to ScarletDiagnosticRecorder.allowedFields; add contract test that all guest_content_geometry_probe relay keys are present in recorder allowlist, keeping guest geometry, SDK version, audio and keyboard behavior intact; route R6P26 native build and unsigned IPA.
entries.observation: Current device R6P25 source SHA 4a6fe9b at 09:16-09:17 UTC: 204 events, PID 7583 8 raw unsafe controls/7 unsafe images but all four R6P25 fields missing. entries.repeat_policy: Reject modifications to UI safe-area/scroll insets until visible/clipped counters actually appear in device JSONL. If missing even after R6P26, inspect embedded signed LiveProcess/framework binary identity and bridge, not repeat the same allowlist patch.

entries.action: Based on R6P28 device readback, perform a single bounded UIKit-managed contentInsetAdjustmentBehavior NEVER->AUTOMATIC trial only on a different full-viewport, nonvertical residual nearest scroll owner with >=2 visible unsafe controls and exact root/local safeTop and no existing inset, at 1850ms after the prior 1100ms nested-header repair. Do not write contentInset, root Safe Area, UIWindow, frame, scale or guest layout constraints. At 2030ms remeasure the SAME owner; retain only if UIKit supplies top inset approximately equal to verified 62pt AND that owner's visible unsafe controls decrease. Otherwise restore original .never behavior and scroll offset. Send anonymous outcome and readbacks through the guest bridge and whitelist. Preserve P28 regression scope and add 3 new static tests plus separate unsigned R6P29 CI artifact. CI first-pass isolated R6P22 legacy regression failed because the L063-only no-override assertion accidentally scanned newer R6P29 source; corrected the test scope to stop at the R6P28 section, preserving original behavior assertion.

entries.repeat_policy: L063 manually adds scroll.contentInset on one tall vertical global scroller; L071 directly adds one short nested header owner's measured local 9pt delta. R6P29 only switches UIKit's adjustment policy on a different full-viewport nonvertical owner with 0 current inset, and requires both measured OS inset and reduced visible overlap, otherwise immediate rollback. Do NOT repeat manual root/scroll inset repairs or claim success from event alone. Recheck portrait/landscape, visual/touch, A/B stability and UI size on signed iPhone; if unavailable, stop rather than weakening guards.

source_revisions.title: fix(r6p29): guarded UIKit automatic adjustment on independent residual fullscreen scroll owner
diag(r6p29): relay bounded automatic inset proof and rollback to device JSONL
diag(r6p29): preserve bounded automatic inset measurements in recorder
test(r6p29): keep R6P28 no-override assertions limited to the original repair
test(r6p29): distinguish residual fullscreen UIKit auto-inset from earlier manual owner repair
ci(r6p29): native Xcode regression gate and distinct unsigned residual-owner IPA release

generated_runtime_targets.note: CI copies tracked Objective-C source template into pinned upstream LiveContainer/Tweaks; generated file not a separately tracked Git patch.

entries.action: Remove only the R6P28 call that mutates a guest-owned nested scroll (3->12pt) after iPhone shows it is overwritten and triggers spatial regression; preserve the immutable L071 source for audit. Once per guest-root report explicit guest_local_owner_r6p28_quarantined receipt. Retain L063 non-interfering original classifier and independent L072 guarded UIKit automatic owner experiment. When L072 cannot find exact owner, emit anonymized non-identifying gate histogram: owner groups with >=2 visible unsafe controls, frame match, safeArea match, inset match, contentHeight match and motion/adjustment state match. Relay to host JSONL and recorder allowlist. Adjust tests expecting unsafe P28 call; add dedicated regression suite and distinct CI IPA.
entries.hypothesis: The P28 manual contentInset is on a guest-owned scroll and is overwritten by guest layout after a receipt declared immediate success, while the scroll owner shifts frame by -27pt and local safe area changes +27pt (y50->23, safeTop12->39, rootSafe62 unchanged). Thus it is unwise to treat the changed adjustedInset value at 1100ms as durable, and its perturbation likely interferes with L072's independent full-viewport owner selection. Quarantine the manual mutation to observe the native hierarchy without self-generated drift, and make L072 exclusions discriminable rather than blindly loosening selectors.

R6P28 immediate guest_local_owner_inset_applied before3->after12; at 1850ms P29 guest_residual_auto_skipped no_matching_fullscreen_owner, visible controls6; by 2600ms header y23 safe39 inset3, unsafe visible controls9/images8. Previous SourceCommit f00c0d4 PID698 by 2600ms residual3 controls/images2; not repeatable. PID1052 unsafe controls0 one image outside scroll at2600ms. Real improvement unproven. P30 signed real device SourceCommit04d2930ee603 PID1392: 650/2600 both owner y50 safe12 adjustedInset3, 8 visible unsafe controls/6 images; regression 8->9 from P29 eliminated. Independent R6P29 .automatic trial now reached one fullscreen owner but produced inset0->0 and kept 3 unsafe owner controls, emitted guest_residual_auto_reverted no_measured_overlap_reduction. P28 quarantine receipt source path executed but original result was [REDACTED] by privacy sanitization due long string containing digits. New P30 c1e6cef0 PID1604 shows the residual fullscreen owner scrollEnabled=0 at2600ms, while 1850ms candidate_inset_matched=0/candidate_state_matched=0 with candidate frame/safe/content all matched. Confirms P29 no owner matched in earlier launch due both native-state and transient-inset predicates; P31 code retained scrollEnabled=true gate and would skip this stable disabled-scroll owner.

entries.repeat_policy: Signed P29 cc5bafc85b66 proves R6P28 direct short-owner inset is overwritten by guest layout, shifts owner y50->23 and increases visible unsafe controls8->9/images6->8. Keep the old mutator quarantined; do not reapply root/window/frame/scale/manual content inset changes. Require stable signed-iPhone 2600ms visual/touch evidence before claiming a fix.

entries.action: From R6P30 real iPhone native candidate success but .automatic adjusted inset 0->0, use Apple's distinct UIScrollViewContentInsetAdjustmentAlways (guaranteed to include the safe-area inset even for non-scrollable/short content). Call only on the unique exact full-viewport y0 owner with root/local safeTop62 and >=2 verified visible unsafe controls; preserve original guest contentInset, root/frame/scale and forbid P28 manual writer. After UIKit adjustedInset reaches expected 62, anchor only the selected scroll's contentOffset to its *OS-generated* negative adjusted inset (no contentInset writes). Recount SAME owner at 180ms and beyond original 2600ms baseline at 3130ms. On non-inset, no decrease, lost owner, relayout reversion, gesture, or unexpected offset, restore .never and guest original offset. Separate staged/reverted/retained sanitized receipts; fix P30 quarantine log sanitizer [REDACTED] issue by removing numeric version in event and explicit host relay. Route new versioned R6P31 unsigned Xcode paired build, add targeted tests and immutable per-commit ledger.
entries.hypothesis: Apple UIKit documents `.automatic` always vertically adjusting only in specific navigation/tab controller owned content circumstances. Resident LC fullscreen owner is non-scrollable content height88-100%, and P30 real device measured `.automatic` remained 0. UIKit `.always` explicitly includes safe-area insets despite this hierarchy, and using the OS-generated inset as the content offset may anchor affected controls below the island without resizing the UIWindow or applying another manual content inset. The two-phase readback prevents the false positive created by L071's immediately overwritten 3->12 contentInset.

entries.repeat_policy: L063 direct global manual scroll.contentInset, L071 short nested manual inset (overwritten and worsened geometry), L072 `.automatic` on full viewport (readback zero), L073 quarantine and diagnostics. R6P31 changes neither global/manual inset nor frames: new mechanism is UIKit `.always` vs `.automatic`, supported by Apple documentation, for a non-scrollable content owner, with OS-generated inset anchor plus 3130ms durability measurement. Do not claim device UI fixed unless 650/2600/3130 measurements, visible/touch and no display resize prove it. If `.always` also produces zero or leaves controls unchanged, rollback and seek different owner/layout cause rather than cycling further enum values.

With that interference removed, P29 unique fullscreen owner WAS selected, yet UIKit AUTOMATIC read back 0pt and left 3 unsafe controls; Apple's ALWAYS policy differs specifically by unconditionally including safe-area insets on non-scrollable short content. R6P31 tests that new behavior and anchors contentOffset only to UIKit-computed adjusted inset, then re-verifies at 3130ms rather than trusting a transient write.

generated_runtime_targets.note: CI overlays tracked Objective-C code onto pinned LiveContainer guest; original guest app window/scale/frames retained; only unique ScrollView OS-managed adjustment changes conditionally.

entries.action: Signed R6P30 second session proves residual full-viewport scroll owner uses scrollEnabled=false, which R6P31's P29-derived gate explicitly excluded despite UIKit ALWAYS safe-area property being meaningful for non-scrollable content. Update only ALWAYS branch candidate gate to `(always || candidate.scrollEnabled)` while retaining the AUTOMATIC legacy scrollEnabled requirement, unsafe-descendant score>=2, unique owner, strict y0/full-window width/height, content size, safeTop62, zero inset/offset, .never, inactive gestures, portrait, attached root. If candidate fails transient inset/state at 1850ms, record exact sanitized owner predicate counters including stationary-owner count and retry ONCE after 900ms native relayout at2750ms, never loop or loosen inset bounds. Call existing L074 UIKit ALWAYS trial and its 180ms plus 1100ms readbacks only on selected stable native owner, restore previous behavior/offset on failure; add recorder/host receipts, specific tests and versioned unsigned paired Xcode build. Do not change other UI, source engine, window size/scale, UIKit root additionalSafeAreaInsets or contentInset.
entries.hypothesis: P30 signed c1e6cef0 PID1604 at 1850ms had one owner matching window frame, safe area and content height but not inset/state. At2600ms, owner is y0, width103%, height100%, safeTop62, content100%, contentInset0, adjustedInset0, contentOffset0, adjustmentBehavior NEVER, scrollEnabled0. P31 checks scrollEnabled true and thus would never test Apple's ALWAYS on this owner, even when late geometry is stable. A single late retry plus disabled-scroll eligibility specifically in ALWAYS corrects candidate selection; unlike L071, no manual change to native contentInset, so false positive regression is handled by L074 late measurement and rollback.
entries.observation: Signed P30 SourceCommit04d2930ee603, current session c1e6cef0 PID1604 iOS27.2: 650ms unsafe visible controls8/images6, header y50 localSafe12 adjusted3 and scan_capped true; 1850ms guest_residual_auto_classifier owner_groups1, candidate_with_controls1, frame1,safe1,content1,inset0,state0, no_matching_fullscreen_owner; 2600ms unsafe controls4/images4, full-viewport owner y0 height100% width103%, localSafe62, adjustedInset0, contentInset0, behaviorNever2, scrollEnabled0, offset0, contentHeight100%, scan_capped true. PID1597 650/2600 controls0/images1. No R6P31 or R6P32 signed-device experiment shown.
entries.device_verification: R6P30 signed evidence only, R6P31 native CI pass/unsigned release, R6P32 not built/signed/device tested.
entries.repeat_policy: Do not count version rename or another timing change as a new visual solution. L063 attempted manual scroll inset; L071 nested manual content inset was overwritten and worsened controls; L072 tried .automatic (0->0); L073 quarantined L071; L074 introduced .always and late confirm but inherited ineligible scrollEnabled true. L075 fixes proven factual eligibility exclusion only; do not claim island fixed until signed iPhone .always trial records nonzero adjustedInset, fewer visible unsafe controls at immediate and late reads, and touch+full-screen unchanged. On continued failure, investigate actual view hierarchy/content positions instead of adding more inset policies.

novelty.causal_difference: Different from L074's change of UIKit adjustment policy: L075 changes only predicate on `scrollEnabled=false` (the exact logged native control state) and single delayed reclassification after observed 1850ms→2600ms layout transition. A non-scrolling fullscreen UIScrollView may still own unsafe controls, while R6P31's inherited P29 gate categorically excluded it. No second manual inset or screen resize; still uses existing L074 adjustment and rollback.
novelty.falsifiable_prediction: On signed R6P32 iPhone with observed PID1604-like owner, initial 1850ms classifier should show candidate_disabled_scroll>=1, and if inset unstable first pass result `guest_always_owner_retry_scheduled` exactly once. At2750ms stable zero-inset owner can be selected despite scrollEnabled=false; either `guest_always_trial_staged` then retained or reverted after readback or explicit `guest_always_owner_retry_exhausted`. A second retry or changed screen size is a regression. Actual failure may still occur if UIKit does not move controls on disabled scroll.

new_device_evidence.observed_value: 1850ms candidate with controls1/frame1/safe1/content1/inset0/state0; 2600ms fullscreen owner y0 width103% height100% safeTop62 inset0 offset0 scrollEnabled0 and 4 unsafe controls/4 images, all before R6P31 experiment.

before: UIWindow *window, UIViewController *root, CGFloat expectedTop, BOOL always) {

after: // R6P32: P30 signed iPhone PID1604 shows the full-viewport
// owner has scrollEnabled=0 once stable. This is a stationary
// UIScrollView whose child controls still intrude into the island.
// UIKit ALWAYS is specifically allowed to manage this owner;
// never alter scrollEnabled or enable gestures. Preserve the legacy
// P30 PID1604: at 1850ms one full-window owner matched frame,
// safeTop and height, but its inset and state gates differed
// scrollEnabled0). Retry ONCE after native layout settles.
"""R6P32 iPhone P30 c1e6cef0: stationary fullscreen residual owner.
y0, height100%, width103%, safeTop62, adjustedInset0, behaviorNEVER,
content100%, scrollEnabled0, offset0; 4 unsafe controls/4 images.
R6P31's ALWAYS path still required scrollEnabled=YES. R6P32 changes
candidate readiness/eligibility, not the UIKit inset/visual strategy.
self.assertIn("weakWindow, weakRoot, expectedTop, NO, YES", G)
self.assertIn("weakWindow, weakRoot, expectedTop, YES, NO", G)

source_revisions.title: fix(r6p32): allow stationary non-scrolling fullscreen UIKit owner and retry once after late relayout, no frame/inset writes
diag(r6p32): relay strict candidate non-scroll exclusion and bounded retry receipts to signed iPhone logs
diag(r6p32): allowlist numeric disabled-scroll and deferred-pass receipts without identities
test(r6p32): assert disabled-scroll full-screen owner eligibility with single bounded geometry retry
ci(r6p32): add stationary-owner gate stabilization branch and isolated unsigned iOS IPA release

generated_runtime_targets.note: Only branch guard predicate and delayed retry in same method; Apple's UIWindow/UIViews/display scale retain unchanged geometry. Exact source hunks above.

novelty.causal_difference: Keep the existing ALWAYS policy, candidate predicates and every timer. Fix its unhandled readiness transition: P31/P32 anchor synchronously only, but later positive adjustedInset was measured without anchoring. At the existing 180ms readback consume an unattempted anchor only if the initial inset was not valid, current inset is valid, the exact guest owner remains active/stationary and its offset is unchanged. Never retry an attempted/rejected setter. Record initial and readback offsets to falsify the hypothesis.
novelty.falsifiable_prediction: If delayed native inset readiness is the cause, receipt shows initial_inset=0, observed_inset=62, anchor_attempts=1, final_offset=-62 and fewer unsafe controls immediately and late. If initial inset was already62, attempted setter was reset, app is backgrounded or controls stay fixed, no extra write; log distinguishes those cases and rollback remains. This is a conditional repair, not evidence of visual success.

new_device_evidence.observed_value: PID1940 owner_auto_before_pt0 after62, owner controls3 remaining3, no_immediate_geometry_improvement; root650/2600 controls8 images6. Home at12:29:05.285 before readback12:29:05.467. Initial inset and actual offset were absent, so async readiness, guest override and background state remain distinct hypotheses.

novelty.why_prior_fix_failed: L074 only anchors in the synchronous valid-inset branch; its later readback verifies a positive inset but cannot consume the skipped anchor. L075 enabled the candidate but did not change that control flow. Device proves inset availability at readback but cannot tell when it first became available; this patch is conditional and logs both phases rather than asserting a cause.

source_revisions.title: diag(r6p35): trace severe unsafe UIKit control ancestors past P34 eight-hop cap without touching guest layout
diag(r6p35): preserve numeric unsafe-control ancestor chain in signed host JSONL
diag(r6p35): allowlist only bounded numeric ancestor ownership facts
test(r6p35): enforce read-only capped-ancestry evidence and no repeat inset mutations
ci(r6p35): native signed-guest ancestor proof with distinct unsigned iOS IPA release

generated_runtime_targets.note: Adds only two-control ancestor-chain readback at late2600ms, no mutation of UIKit hierarchy or owner scroll.

entries.action: Signed P35 second guest root-safe62 produced no 650/2600ms guest_content_geometry_probe and therefore no deep ancestor proof, while the first guest yielded both. Instrument existing once-per-root content probe scheduling with a bounded anonymous 'guest_geometry_probe_status(scheduled)' receipt, then report which exact guard prevents snapshots (weak window released, weak root stale/replaced, window hidden/non-normal, scene absent/nonportrait, root view detached, root safe area unready, invalid frame). Record only PID, sample index, root/scene presence and bounded numeric flags. At *original* 2600ms read ONLY, if weak root has been replaced, evaluate the currently attached root of the SAME original live normal UIWindow with all existing portrait/scene/safe/window gates before performing the unchanged P35 content/ancestor geometry probes. At 650ms a root change is logged and skipped. No extra timer, observer loop, app-specific exception, frame/window/root resize, contentInset, contentOffset, SafeArea mutator or screen mask. Relay closed reason strings and numeric state to host JSONL via current P35 anonymous bridge and recorder, update historical P18 test to validate the attached-root call, add 6 new regressions, distinct Xcode paired CI/unsigned IPA and full commit diffs. After local source diff review, normalize the new receipt's NSUUID constructor to the exact established Objective-C `NSUUID.UUID.UUIDString` style rather than the accidentally duplicated `.UUID` token; preserve this compile-focused correction in the same audited revision.
entries.hypothesis: In P35 real iPhone PID3252, the guest root-safe receipt confirms the guard executed, and host foreground remained live >30s, yet neither scheduled geometry sample is present. The existing dispatch_after kept only weak UIWindow/root and its ScarletIslandContentProbe had multiple silent early-return gates; an original root replacement/detachment or scene change can cause both observations to vanish without logging. This is a measurable instrumentation gap, not proof that the guest has no overlap. Make all guard exits observable; using the currently attached root on the already-scheduled late sample can recover geometry when the original view controller changed. If no scheduled receipt appears, the root-scheduling callback itself or shared bridge must be investigated instead of retrying inset policies.
entries.observation: P35 SourceCommit75455528540a at 2026-11-12T14:06:59Z session3d8246a5 current-run 234 events: guest PID3244 root-safe62, 650ms candidate_controls22/visible_unsafe_controls0, 2600ms candidate_controls13/visible_unsafe_controls0/images1 outside scroll, no severe control so ancestor probe absent. Guest PID3252 root receipt 'guest_root_already_safe' and quarantine events with SafeArea62, no guest_content_geometry_probe or guest_ancestor_layout_probe. Real cause of missing callback not observable; late 2600ms root-current fallback and explicit skip receipts needed. Auth initially restored then became unavailable on foreground, manual_blocked auth_unavailable, 2FA stored_session_verified and host_session_restored later; subsequent provider unchanged and SideStore signing ready; no manual native refresh operation or error executed. Recent guest register 1->2 and rendered count2; audio and keyboard process ACK not functional proof.
entries.device_verification: P35 signed device evidence verified, R6P36 not yet built or device tested
entries.repeat_policy: DO NOT retry L063/L071 manual inset, L072 AUTOMATIC, L074/L076 ALWAYS/offset, root/window frame mutation or old timing adjustments. L061 already increased descendant depth cap, L077 inspected constraints to eight ancestors and L079 traced up to24 but guest second process produced NO geometry; L080 is strictly the formerly SILENT missing-snapshot guard and conditional attached-root observation at the existing late sample, not another SafeArea repair. Never claim Island fixed until real signed iPhone second-guest geometry readback and visible/touch UI improvements. If 'scheduled' appears but no sample/skip, inspect main queue/suspension or ring/bridge; if 'scheduled' missing, inspect original P35 scheduling/observer attach. If root_replaced, compare actual attached lineage rather than scaling/reinsetting.

novelty.causal_difference: Unlike L079's extra ancestor-depth scanner that never ran for PID3252, L080 instrumented the *earlier* root/window time-scoped callback whose absence is actually observed, and adds only one conditional read-only fallback to live attached root at the existing 2600ms sample. Unlike L074/L075 timing changes to try inset mutators, L080 has no layout-write code and retains the original two sample times. Distinguishes missing owner from missing callback and actively prevents false zero-control conclusions.
novelty.falsifiable_prediction: Next R6P36 signed iPhone launch: for each PID with guest_root_already_safe, record exactly one guest_geometry_probe_status scheduled per root and either guest_content_geometry_probe at650/2600 or explicit guest_geometry_probe_status root_stale/window_released/window_ineligible/scene_ineligible/root_detached/safe_unready/frame_invalid. If old root is replaced, at2600 emit root_replaced and inspect attached new root only after eligibility checks. A still-missing both-status-and-geometry PID indicates observer/transport/suspension outside proposed cause; do not claim UI fixed.

Manual refresh blocked auth_unavailable before user 2FA; no underlying native exception evidence.
